candidate_tasks.title: Loop-width comparison ODE integrating-factor formula
candidate_tasks.proposed_Lean_statement_or_precise_contr: For continuous Rmin : ℝ → ℝ and a,t' : ℝ, let w solve w' = -2π - (1/2) Rmin(t) w with w(t') = a on an interval containing [t', t'']. Conclude w(t'') = exp(-B) * (a - 2π ∫_{t'}^{t''} exp(B_{t'}(s)) ds) with B_{t'}(t) = ∫_{t'}^t (1/2) Rmin. If a' ≥ a then w_{a'}(t'') - w_a(t'') = (a'-a) exp(-B) ≥ 0. State for an arbitrary continuous coefficient, not a Ricci-flow predicate, so the conclusion is not assumed in the hypotheses.
known_dependencies: Mathlib ODE/integrating-factor and interval integrals (to be used, not re-proved as a Ricci-flow theorem)
candidate_tasks.independence: Scalar ODE only. Independent of collar, surgery spacetime, Plateau, and curve shrinking. Same ODE appears for W2 with 4π in place of 2π; keep 2π as the loop-width contract and do not encode extinction.
